why: Lossless JPEG expands on high-entropy input. The arena was sized from the packed raster (848 bytes of headroom), so an overrun destroyed the size table before the post-hoc sum could read it. Capacity is now enforced before the fact.

model.derivation: max over category distributions of E[SSSS] + H(p) + 1
model.caveat: Models optimal per-image Huffman. A fixed table in the camera's encoder could exceed it; unverified.

measured_host.note: Noise EXPANDS to 1.126x the packed raster.

decision.512x512_verdict: REFUSED at build time: bounds at 5,506,098 B, above the entire 4 MiB allocation. Every live measurement before 2026-09-23 used this geometry.

tests.enforcement: build_image refuses any encode kind whose bound exceeds the arena; a test restores the old arena and asserts all three builds refuse

still_open: the camera's actual Huffman table is unknown; the bound models optimal coding
the padding contract is decoded from edge tiles, not proven; padding is bounded at full cost here rather than relying on the cheaper reading
no live 512x368 measurement exists yet (ROADMAP G2)

corrections.found_by: BUFFER_RESEARCH.md 4.3, which names a 7-byte drift between two estimates
corrections.what_was_wrong: Nothing recorded here. This entry carried the tool's number, 3,957,839. The drift was on the other side: single_frame_codec_probe.py inlined the model's 13.999823... as the literal 13.9998 and then TRUNCATED the product with int() instead of taking a ceiling. Both roundings went the same way, so the build-time gate that is supposed to REFUSE an unsafe geometry was computing 3,957,832 - seven bytes BELOW the bound recorded here. A gate that is the permissive copy of a bound is not a gate.
corrections.what_changed: Both implementations now call one integer formula: padded_samples * BOUND_BITS // 8 + tiles * 96, with BOUND_BITS = 14, the smallest integer above the numerical supremum 13.999823879015727. No float enters the arithmetic, so the two cannot drift by a rounding. At 512x368 the bound is now 3,957,888 B, 49 B above the value recorded here and 56 B above what the probe was using.
corrections.does_not_change: The MODEL is unchanged and still excludes entropy-coded FF 00 byte stuffing, so this remains a bound for the modelled contract, not a proof about the hardware. The 2.30% margin against the compressed capacity of 4,048,896 B is therefore still optimistic.
